inbox.body: Northern Lights Boxing would like Jack Barrett to face Josh Thorne, a regional matchup that makes sense for both. They are offering a place on Northern Lights Boxing 1: Leeds, Leeds. The offer stands for 3 weeks.

inbox.body: Presentation Night is on sale. Watch sales each week and adjust prices or marketing if it is slow.

inbox.subject: Ironside Gym Supplies is interested
inbox.body: Ironside Gym Supplies — a local fitness retailer that wants its name on the ring apron — would like to become an official partner of P48. Their offer is waiting on the Sponsors screen for the next eight weeks.

inbox.subject: Fight offer: Josh Thorne v Lachlan Gleeson
inbox.body: Lone Star Fight Night think Lachlan Gleeson (14-9-1) and Josh Thorne (2-1-0) are well matched, and that the fight would mean something in the division. They want you to host it. The offer stands for 4 weeks.

inbox.subject: Fight offer: Josh Thorne v Tyrese Hawkins
inbox.body: Golden State Prizefights think Tyrese Hawkins (26-7-1) and Josh Thorne (2-1-0) are well matched, and that the fight would mean something in the division. They want you to host it. The offer stands for 4 weeks.

inbox.subject: Word on the circuit: Leandro Ledesma
inbox.body: People in the gyms are talking about Leandro Ledesma (Mendoza, 21-38-1). You may want to take a look.

inbox.subject: Josh Thorne wants a fight
inbox.body: Josh Thorne has not fought for 42 weeks and the contract promises at least 3 a year. Their camp is getting restless.

inbox.subject: Fight agreed: Jordan Whitlock vs Bradley Brennan
inbox.body: Bradley Brennan's camp has agreed terms: £12,500 purse. Choose a date to schedule the fight.

inbox.subject: Counter-offer from Bradley Brennan's camp
inbox.body: They want changes: a few adjustments.

inbox.subject: Fight agreed: Nurlan Tolegen vs Elijah Coleman
inbox.body: Elijah Coleman's camp has agreed terms: £133,000 purse. Choose a date to schedule the fight.

inbox.subject: Elijah Coleman turns down the fight
inbox.body: Elijah Coleman's camp said no: their promotion is wary of an unproven rival promoter; wants a bigger purse.

inbox.subject: Fight agreed: Ricardo Barrientos vs Marcus Banks
inbox.body: Marcus Banks's camp has agreed terms: £6,900 purse. Choose a date to schedule the fight.

inbox.subject: Counter-offer from Marcus Banks's camp
inbox.body: They want changes: a few adjustments.

inbox.subject: Meet your first fighters
inbox.body: Your gym is home to Ricardo Barrientos, Nurlan Tolegen, Jordan Whitlock, Josh Thorne. Set each fighter's training focus from their profile — it changes how they develop every week.

inbox.subject: Welcome to P48
inbox.body: T, the paperwork is signed and the doors are open. You have 4 fighters, a gym and £500k in the bank. Every week the bills land and the rest of boxing moves on without you. Scout the market, book a show, and watch the forecast before you commit.
